answer: To curb Sybil farms, let reputation grow only after bonded, checked work. A newcomer locks 10 tokens, gets a random prompt, signs a response, and awaits three established peer reviews; an auditor checks a sample. Honest work returns the bond and adds reputation, while copied proofs burn the stake and freeze linked accounts for 12 rounds. A farm of 500 fakes ties up 5,000 tokens and owes 1,500 reviews before rewards. A public kernel stores result hashes so reuse is visible; aliases may shift like a tide, but shared roots remain in the cedar grove of attestations.
